boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented John Carroll environments for quiet work, group sessions, technology-supported projects, and course-related research.

cards.title: James J. McDonough ’55 Study Space
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Grasselli Library
cards.notes: Bring individual coursework to this enclosed quiet study room on the library’s quiet floor; choose it when you need a focused indoor setting.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed, 24-seat quiet room on Grasselli Library’s top floor.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s bulletin describes a 24-seat enclosed quiet study room on the top floor of Grasselli Library’s quiet floor; an alumni publication identifies it as the James J. McDonough ’55 Study Space.
cards.source_title: John Carroll University 2021–2022 Undergraduate and Graduate Bulletin
cards.access_notes: Located on the third/top floor of Grasselli Library; room availability is not stated on the source.

cards.entity_name: Private Study Spaces at Grasselli Library
cards.title: Private Study Spaces at Grasselli
cards.subtitle: Grasselli Library & Breen Learning Center
cards.notes: Use a private study space for independent reading or drafting, and check the library’s room-reservation process if your work needs a bookable room.
cards.short_summary: Library-provided private study environments for focused academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s bulletin states that Grasselli Library offers private and group study spaces, including quiet and collaborative study space.
cards.source_title: John Carroll University 2021–2022 Undergraduate and Graduate Bulletin
cards.access_notes: The library’s student-services guide says study rooms may be reserved through CourseDog and require approval.

cards.entity_name: Group Study Spaces at Grasselli Library
cards.title: Group Study Spaces at Grasselli
cards.subtitle: Grasselli Library & Breen Learning Center
cards.notes: Plan a project meeting here, then submit a CourseDog request ahead of time when your group needs a dedicated study room.
cards.short_summary: Bookable library settings for group projects and study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s student-services guide says students can reserve library study rooms for group projects or study sessions through CourseDog.
cards.source_title: Services for Students — Library Guides at John Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Reservation requests use CourseDog and are subject to approval; consult the current room schedule and availability before planning.

cards.title: Computer Commons
cards.subtitle: Main floor, Grasselli Library
cards.notes: Choose this main-floor computer setting when your assignment calls for a desktop workstation instead of relying on a personal device.
cards.short_summary: A 44-seat computer area in the library’s main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s bulletin identifies a 44-seat Computer Commons on the main floor of Grasselli Library.
cards.source_title: John Carroll University 2021–2022 Undergraduate and Graduate Bulletin
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s main floor; current workstation availability is not stated on the source.

cards.title: Center for Digital Media
cards.subtitle: Main floor, Grasselli Library
cards.notes: Use this lab when a class project needs multimedia production tools, then ask staff about available support or equipment checkout options.
cards.short_summary: A supported multimedia lab for presentations, video, graphics, and related projects.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s bulletin says the Center for Digital Media on Grasselli Library’s main floor provides a fully equipped, supported multimedia lab for students.
cards.source_title: John Carroll University 2021–2022 Undergraduate and Graduate Bulletin
cards.access_notes: Main-floor Grasselli Library resource; equipment checkout is handled through the library circulation desk according to the bulletin.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, Grasselli Library
cards.notes: Set up your coursework near peer tutoring and the Writing Center annex when you want academic support close to your study session.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor enrichment area with peer tutors and a Writing Center annex.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s bulletin says the Learning Commons on the ground floor of the library includes peer tutors for courses and a Writing Center annex.
cards.source_title: John Carroll University 2021–2022 Undergraduate and Graduate Bulletin
cards.access_notes: Ground-floor library location; tutoring and Writing Center service availability should be confirmed separately.

cards.title: Grasselli Reading Garden
cards.subtitle: Grasselli Library grounds
cards.notes: Take reading or annotation outdoors in the named Reading Garden, then move back indoors if weather or device needs change.
cards.short_summary: A named open-air reading setting at the library.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s bulletin lists an open-air reading garden among Grasselli Library’s study amenities, and the current campus map names the Grasselli Reading Garden.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark adjacent to the library area; weather-dependent and no seating or hours are specified on the source.

cards.entity_name: Sabo Center for Languages and Cultures
cards.title: Sabo Center for Languages and Cultures
cards.subtitle: OC 101, O’Malley Center
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or use one of the workstations for language and culture coursework; keep food outside this technology-centered academic space.
cards.short_summary: A flexible academic workspace with 24 computer stations and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll says the Sabo Center in OC 101 has 24 computer workstations, flexible collaborative furniture, device tables, and a printing station.
cards.source_title: Sabo Center for Languages and Cultures — John Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open during standard University business hours, 8 AM–5 PM Monday–Friday; outside-hour reservations require contacting the center. Food is not permitted.

cards.title: AMLC Multimedia Library
cards.subtitle: OC 139, O’Malley Center
cards.notes: Reserve this smaller humanities-library setting with your instructor or student organization when a course-related film viewing or small-group session fits the plan.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, 12-seat multimedia and humanities-library space.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll describes the AMLC Multimedia Library in OC 139 as a reservable informal space with an extensive humanities library, theater space, and seating for 12.
cards.source_title: Sabo Center for Languages and Cultures — John Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Reservable by instructors and campus student organizations; standard center hours are 8 AM–5 PM Monday–Friday, with after-hours arrangements through the center.

cards.title: Collaboration Classroom
cards.subtitle: OC 112, O’Malley Center
cards.notes: Use this 24-seat room for organized language-learning work, cultural programming, or a group session that benefits from a classroom-scale setting.
cards.short_summary: A 24-seat classroom that also functions as a Cultural Activities Center.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll says the Collaboration Classroom in OC 112 seats 24 people and also serves as a Cultural Activities Center for guest speakers and experiential language learning.
cards.source_title: Sabo Center for Languages and Cultures — John Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Part of the Sabo Center’s spaces; it is open during standard University business hours and is reservable through CourseDog.
